def test_save_creates_parent_dirs(sample, tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "nested" / "dir" / "inv.json"
    storage.save(sample, path)
    assert path.exists()

def test_report_has_total_line(sample):
    assert any(line.startswith("TOTAL") for line in render_text(sample).splitlines())

def test_load_reports_missing_file_nicely(tmp_path):
    import pytest
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="invoice file not found"):
        storage.load(tmp_path / "missing.json")
